units.source_text: “更有一种人，所选定的对象，未必符合理想；

en.t: There is another kind of man: the person he has chosen may not necessarily match his ideal;

units.source_text: 只因当初一见倾心，此情难于摈除，故而决意成全。

en.t: but because he fell in love at first sight and cannot cast off that feeling, he resolves to see the match through.

units.source_text: 此种男子真可谓忠厚之至；

en.t: Such a man may truly be called faithful and sincere in the highest degree;

units.source_text: 而被爱之女子，必有可取之处，此亦可想而知。

en.t: and the woman who is loved by him must surely have something admirable about her; that too is easy to imagine.

units.source_text: 然而纵观世间种种姻缘配合之状，大都庸庸碌碌，总不见出乎意外之美满姻缘。

en.t: Yet when we look over all the marriages and matches in the world, most are merely ordinary, and we never see an unexpectedly perfect union.

units.source_text: 我等并无奢望，尚且不能找到称心之人；

en.t: Even we, who have no extravagant hopes, still cannot find someone who truly suits us;

units.source_text: 何况你们要求极高，怎样的女子才及格呢？

en.t: so for those of you with such high demands, what kind of woman would ever be good enough?
